notes.title: Alpha 1.3 Loot update
notes.content:
[u]Changes:[/u]
[list]
[*] Added checkpoints
[*] Added medkits
[*] Added hint about saved game when the cursor is over Load button
[*] Added random loot in world
[*] Fixed bug in world editor when Add button was disabled if an existing world is opened
[*] Fixed bug in world editor with selected item label
[*] Fixed bug with drawing background after increasing screen resolution
[/list]

notes.title: Alpha 1.2.1 HotFix
notes.content: HotFix for World editor: fixed displaying new tracks

notes.title: Alpha 1.2.1
notes.content:
Update for World editor.
Now more music tracks are available for creating your own worlds!

[u]Changes:[/u]
[list]
[*] Added 4 new tracks: Deep jungle, Acid ambient, Hurry up, Scary night
[*] Added glow for bullets
[*] Added download indicators for downloading in new game menu and cooperative menu
[*] Fixed bug during loading the world without hints layer
[*] Fixed bug with downloading worlds from players
[/list]

notes.title: Alpha 1.2 World editor update
notes.content:
Dear players!
World editor is now ready. Now you can draw your own worlds and share them with other players!

[u]Changes:[/u]
[list]
[*] Added World editor
[*] Optimized net traffic during shooting
[*] Removed downloading music tracks with worlds
[/list]
